scope: Primary-source research and code review; no physical-device execution

sources.title: Android default dialer
sources.finding: Official call-control roles, not SIM audio permission.

sources.title: Android audio sources
sources.finding: VOICE_CALL requires protected CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT.

sources.title: Android audio input sharing
sources.finding: Voice-call capture restrictions; ordinary microphone does not prove telephony PCM.

sources.title: AOSP IMS
sources.finding: Trusted IMS implementation is configured by carrier/device; not an ordinary third-party SIM-to-SIP API.

sources.title: JemRec README
sources.finding: Embedded ADB setup; answering machine reported on Honor 2G and S23 Wi-Fi Calling; not target-device VoLTE proof.

sources.title: JemRec GreetingPlayer
sources.finding: Telephony preferred-device stream and call-screening injection alternative; file greeting is not implemented AI streaming.

sources.title: JemRec AnswerMachine
sources.finding: Answer/greeting/message/end state machine; outbound AI campaigns not proven.

sources.title: JemRec BootReceiver
sources.finding: Waits for first unlock; schedules recovery after BOOT_COMPLETED.

sources.title: JemRec ADB transport
sources.finding: Local ADB pairing and retained identity, not normal app permissions.

sources.title: JemRec recovery
sources.finding: Revive locking, debug-switch management and readiness handling; OEM-dependent.

sources.title: JemRec manifest
sources.finding: No AccessibilityService/BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE declaration found in reviewed manifest.

sources.title: JemRec notices
sources.finding: Apache-2.0 notices and dependency licensing choice; keep attributions.

sources.title: Callvault
sources.finding: Embedded ADB capture project; injection not verified by this review.

sources.title: scrcpy
sources.finding: Voice-call audio capture sources are not evidence of SIM uplink injection.

sources.title: Shizuku SIP gateway
sources.finding: Real capture/injection code; excluded by owner's Shizuku rejection.

sources.title: Root GSM2SIP
sources.finding: Root/HAL-specific digital route on supported phones; not Redmi Note12 Pro5G proof.

sources.title: GSM2SIP device matrix
sources.finding: Positive and negative device audio-policy evidence; repository-wide license not established by metadata.

sources.title: Root Android SIP gateway
sources.finding: Root/Qualcomm-specific system assumptions.

sources.title: Magick GSM2SIP
sources.finding: Separates non-root signaling from root audio path.

sources.title: Zerkat
sources.finding: Commercial/root supported-device route, not assumed free generic gateway.

sources.title: P2P gateway source
sources.finding: No-root branch states microphone-only acoustic bridge; reviewed playback uses USAGE_MEDIA.

sources.title: Xiaomi audio interception investigation
sources.finding: Author reports exposed interception APIs without usable initialized audio route on another Xiaomi; do not generalize to target phone.

sources.title: GSMCalls gateway
sources.finding: Vendor describes separate audio connection via bridge/PC; excluded hardware requirement.

sources.title: VMGate FAQ
sources.finding: USB dongle required for voice/GSM audio; free tier does not remove hardware.

sources.title: Asterisk Mobile requirements
sources.finding: Bluetooth/HFP computer intermediary is outside no-extra-hardware requirement.

sources.title: Oh My Phone Use
sources.finding: External ESP32/Mac audio/control route, excluded.

sources.title: ElevenAgents prices
sources.finding: Observed $0.08 additional minute/$0.16 burst; LLM and carrier charges separate.

sources.title: Groq speech to text
sources.finding: Whisper turbo $0.04/hour and 10-second minimum billing per request.

sources.title: Fish TTS API pricing
sources.finding: Observed $15/million UTF-8 bytes; do not count Arabic characters as bytes.

sources.title: Groq rate limits
sources.finding: Tier/account-specific limits; not unlimited free production.

sources.title: faster-whisper
sources.finding: MIT code; CPU/GPU inference is not zero infrastructure cost or measured Egyptian Arabic latency.

sources.title: whisper.cpp Android
sources.finding: On-device STT implementation candidate, not modem permission solution.

sources.title: Qwen3-ASR
sources.finding: Apache-2.0 project and Arabic listed; inspect selected model artifact separately.

sources.title: Chatterbox Multilingual
sources.finding: MIT project; Arabic in Multilingual variant. No target-phone realtime benchmark performed.

sources.title: Fish Speech license
sources.finding: Community license and weight-specific exceptions; not blanket Apache/free-commercial assumption.

sources.title: XTTS-v2
sources.finding: Arabic model with CPML; not selected as unrestricted commercial model.

sources.title: F5-TTS
sources.finding: Official pretrained weights CC-BY-NC; code license alone insufficient.

sources.title: Qwen3-TTS
sources.finding: Arabic not established in reviewed base supported-language list; forks do not prove upstream support.

sources.title: Silero VAD
sources.finding: MIT VAD component; not speech recognition, echo cancellation or SIM bridge.

limitations: Prices and mutable references may change.
Search breadth does not establish exhaustive coverage of all existing repositories.
Embedded ADB removes the external Shizuku dependency but retains shell-privilege and OEM dependencies.
